title: Phoenix Shot Tower
visualBrief: Tall tapering red brick shot tower, four aligned west windows and sparse secondary openings, deep segmental arched iron entrance, subtle repair bands, surveyed ten-battlement concrete crown with a muted red painted appearance and flat roof deck, lightning conductors and narrow own footing/entry tread. Neighboring buildings, park monuments and flag fixtures excluded.
